overall_goal: Manage ingredients, clean up workspace, and transfer the pan to the oven

goals.description: Operate the kitchen scales and place the pan on them
goals.rationale: The person turns the scales on and off and places the pan on them to weigh ingredients.

goals.description: Scrape the chopped onion into the pan and handle the chopping board
goals.rationale: The person uses the knife to scrape the onion from the chopping board into the pan, then repeatedly picks up and puts down the board and knife.

goals.description: Scrape food waste into the recycling container
goals.rationale: The person opens the recycling container, scrapes food waste into it, and closes the lid.

goals.description: Unlock the phone and check the recipe
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly picks up their phone, unlocks it, and scrolls through the recipe notes.

goals.description: Put the lids back on various spice containers
goals.rationale: The person picks up lids and screws them back onto the pots of spices they have finished using.
The person picks up measuring spoons and the salt container to get ready for seasoning.

goals.description: Return the spice containers to the spice cupboard
goals.rationale: The person gathers the closed spice containers and arranges them back into the cupboard.

goals.description: Stir the ingredients in the pan
goals.rationale: The person uses a wooden spoon to stir the chillies, garlic, and onion in the pan, shaking it to mix.

goals.description: Transfer the pan into the oven
goals.rationale: The person puts on an oven glove, adjusts the oven shelf, and places the pan on the bottom of the oven.

goals.description: Dispose of leftover rubbish into the recycling container
goals.rationale: The person gathers the remaining food waste from the counter and puts it into the recycling container to tidy the surface.
